evals.prompt: Using the ElevenLabs CLI project conventions, scaffold the local project files and agent configuration for a restaurant reservation assistant. It should be able to check availability, book tables, and confirm reservations. Do not authenticate with or call the ElevenLabs API and do not deploy — produce the agents.json and agent config files only, and document the 'elevenlabs agents push' deploy step in a README.
evals.expected_output: CLI-convention project files and agent configuration for a restaurant reservation voice agent
expectations: Uses 'elevenlabs agents init' or equivalent CLI command to set up the project
Uses 'elevenlabs agents add' or registers the agent in agents.json with a config under agent_configs
Defines a persona prompt for the restaurant reservation assistant in the agent config
Documents 'elevenlabs agents push' as the deploy step
Configures at least one tool for checking availability or booking

evals.prompt: Show me how to embed an ElevenLabs voice agent widget on my React website. The agent ID is 'abc123'.
evals.expected_output: Code showing how to embed the ElevenLabs conversational AI widget
expectations: Uses the elevenlabs-convai web component or React wrapper
Sets abc123 as the agent id value
Shows proper script tag or npm package import for the widget
Provides a working HTML or React component example

evals.prompt: Create an ElevenLabs agent configuration with a custom webhook tool that calls our inventory API at https://api.example.com/inventory to check product stock levels.
evals.expected_output: Agent configuration with webhook tool definition
expectations: Defines a tool with type 'webhook' or equivalent
Configures the request URL as https://api.example.com/inventory
Includes a description for the tool that the LLM can understand
Defines appropriate parameters/schema for the tool
